=== hermes-context/sync-hermes-context.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sync-hermes-context.sh — one-way host->workspace mirror of the hermes context.
# A2 one-way (no writeback), A5 recursive mirror, A6/A16 zero-write --dry-run,
# A11 stage -> content-verify -> touch DST, A9-class compare (contents+structure+symlinks).
set -euo pipefail

MODE=run
case "${1-}" in
  --dry-run) MODE=dry ;;
  --verify)  MODE=verify ;;
  "")        MODE=run ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 [--dry-run|--verify]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

die() { echo "sync-hermes-context: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---- A23/A18: resolve SRC/DST from env (unset -> production default; set-but-empty -> refuse)
resolve() {
  local which=$1 raw
  if [ "$which" = SRC ]; then raw=${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC-default /opt/data/workspace/hermes-context}
  else raw=${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST-default /workspace/hermes-context}; fi
  # NOTE: the defaults above contain a space due to doc formatting safety; strip to the path token
  case "$raw" in
    "default"*) raw=${raw#default } ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$raw" ] && die "A23: $which env var is set but empty — refusing"
  while [ "$raw" != "/" ] && [ "$raw" != "${raw%/}" ]; do raw=${raw%/}; done
  [ "$raw" = "/" ] || [ "$raw" = "." ] && die "A18: degenerate path for $which ('/', '.', or empty) — refusing"
  printf '%s' "$raw"
}

SRC=$(resolve SRC)
DST=$(resolve DST)

[ -d "$SRC" ] || die "source directory not found: $SRC (A2: read-only on source)"

# ---- canonical paths (trailing slashes stripped once, above); realpath for identity checks
RS=$(realpath -m -- "$SRC")
RD=$(realpath -m -- "$DST")

# ---- A12: identity / ancestor / descendant (realpath component tests, never string prefixes of raw env)
[ "$RS" = "$RD" ] && die "A12: SRC and DST resolve to the same path ($RS)"
[ "${RD}/" = "${RS}/"* ] 2>/dev/null || true
case "${RD}/" in "${RS}/"*) die "A12: DST resolves inside SRC ($RD inside $RS)";; esac
case "${RS}/" in "${RD}/"*) die "A12: SRC resolves inside DST ($RS inside $RD)";; esac

# ---- A22: DST itself is a symlink (outside SRC; inside-SRC already caught by A12) — refuse, never replace
if [ -L "$DST" ]; then
  die "A22: DST ($DST) is a symlink — refusing to replace a user-placed symlink"
fi

# ---- A14/A15: owned concrete paths = log dir + entrypoint dir (component-boundary compare)
LOGP=$(realpath -m -- "${HOME}/.cache/hermes-context")
SDIR=$(realpath -m -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")
owned_check() {
  local p=$1 o
  for o in "$LOGP" "$SDIR"; do
    [ "$p" = "$o" ] && return 1
    case "$p/" in "$o"/*) return 1 ;; esac   # DST inside owned
    case "$o/" in "$p"/*) return 1 ;; esac   # owned inside DST
  done
  return 0
}
owned_check "$RD" || die "A14/A15: DST ($RD) collides with an owned path (log dir: $LOGP, entrypoint dir: $SDIR)"
